summary: BBVA files a Form 6-K reporting an update on its ongoing share buyback program (Third Tranche). Between 8 June and 12 June 2026, the company purchased shares for €738.5 million, representing about 50.58% of the maximum cash amount of the Third Tranche. This is a routine capital return update under a previously announced buyback, not an event-driven special situation. The filing does not involve a tender offer, activist campaign, or structural change. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the filing merely reports transactions executed by the manager, Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG. There is no risk-arb angle or unusual mechanics; it is a standard periodic disclosure for an open-market repurchase program.
